name: Review of AI components
reviewer: A named person. Qualification and rules for reviewers are public at https://human-reviewed.com/governance/
what_is_checked: declared limits in three levels: may do alone, only with a person's confirmation, never
handling of hidden instructions in inputs

result.today: Written report and review note with reviewer name, date, version, digest, the three limit lists and the outcome.
result.planned: Public entry in the Human-reviewed register as JSON. The entry type and a draft standard are published for comment at https://human-reviewed.com/standard/ai-components/ ; no entry exists until the first review is done.

advantages_and_how_to_verify.advantage: Limits are tested, not just claimed
advantages_and_how_to_verify.verify: Compare the three limit lists with the permissions the component requests.
Compare the digest in the note with the files you load; a mismatch means the review does not cover what you run.

advantages_and_how_to_verify.advantage: A named person who can be asked
advantages_and_how_to_verify.verify: Name, qualification and date are on the note.
Check the valid-until date (at most 12 months) and the status.

advantages_and_how_to_verify.advantage: Faster decisions for platforms and customers
advantages_and_how_to_verify.verify: Scope and limits can be read without a questionnaire.

advantages_and_how_to_verify.advantage: Component is reviewed, not the model
advantages_and_how_to_verify.verify: Result stays valid with another model while the version and limits stay the same.

validity: One version, at most 12 months. A material change ends it.
launch_offer: Half price for the first reviews. Terms are agreed in writing before commissioning.
who_can_commission: A responsible person or company. An agent can prepare and send a request; a person confirms it.
how_to_request: Email a description of the component (name, version, owner, location, permissions, data). Do not send keys or credentials.
not_included: statement about the AI model itself
notice: This file contains no instructions for AI systems.
